pokedexEntries.su: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

pokedexEntries.mo: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

pokedexEntries.us: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It’s a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

pokedexEntries.um: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

pokedexEntries.sc: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

pokedexEntries.vi: It spends its waking hours searching for food. When Yungoos is hungry, its ferocity gains a certain edge.
